build_granite_causal_lm: build a GraniteForCausalLM inference model from a HuggingFace GraniteConfig with optional quantization
create_granite_decoder_layer: create a GraniteDecoderLayer with attention, MLP, and RMSNorm using GraniteConfig parameters
run_granite_forward_pass: run a forward pass on GraniteForCausalLM with input_ids, positions, and a ForwardBatch for inference
load_granite_weights: load HuggingFace-compatible weights into GraniteForCausalLM with stacked parameter splitting support
get_granite_weights_by_name: get model weights by parameter name from GraniteForCausalLM with tensor parallel sharding support
